sidecar.title: Meridian Defense Systems C2 Platform Program: Weekly Status Report
sidecar.report:
Meridian Defense Systems C2 Platform Program: Weekly Status Report
Report date: 2026-09-24

MILESTONES & RISKS

Authority to Operate (ATO) Approval is behind its original schedule, with the cybersecurity ATO documentation task overdue since 2026-09-10 and blocked pending ISSO review. The forecast date has slipped to 2026-10-14, roughly two weeks past the 2026-09-30 plan, consistent with the ISSO office's informal estimate of a 2-3 week delay.

Critical Design Review (CDR) is not on track because the radar feed adapter integration, a direct CDR dependency, was due September 12, 2026 and remains in progress as of September 24, with the team expecting at least another week of delay due to incomplete vendor API documentation. CDR is planned for November 15, 2026, so there is some runway, but readiness depends on resolving this overdue task. The reported "On Track" status should be corrected to reflect this overdue, dependency-linked work. RISK-021 (subcontractor staffing gap on fusion engine team) is Closed and can be removed from the risk registrar.

Customer Demo / IOC Readiness Review is on track for its 2026-12-01 date, with the test plan update in progress and due today and the customer-requested dry-run logistics task not due until 2026-10-01. The dry-run logistics task still has no assignee despite the customer's explicit request, so it should be tracked closely as the due date nears.
